entries.name: DuckDuckGo search
entries.description: Type ddg and some words to search DuckDuckGo; ddg alone opens its home page. Runs no code.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Developer search
entries.description: Keywords so, mdn, crate, docsrs, npm and pypi search Stack Overflow, MDN, crates.io, docs.rs, npm and PyPI in your browser. Runs no code.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: GitHub search
entries.description: ghr, ghi and ghu search GitHub repositories, issues and pull requests, and people in your browser. Runs no code.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Wikipedia search
entries.description: Type wiki and some words to search Wikipedia; the language is a variable you can change. Runs no code.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Maps search
entries.description: map opens a place search on OpenStreetMap, gmap on Google Maps. Runs no code.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Open selection as a link
entries.description: Universal Actions: select a web address in any app and open it; bare addresses get https, anything else is refused. Runs no code.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Tidy up whitespace
entries.description: Universal Actions: select text in any app, collapse its spaces and line breaks, and paste it back. Runs no code.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Markdown helpers
entries.description: Universal Actions: turn the selection into a Markdown link, bold, code, a quote or a bullet list. Runs no code.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Decode and encode
entries.description: Universal Actions: decode Base64 or URL-encoded text in a text view, or encode the selection and copy it. Runs no code.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Selection toolkit (Python)
entries.description: Universal Actions: count words, pretty-print or minify JSON, convert timestamps and dates. Runs a short offline Python 3 script after you allow it.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Case converter (Node, Alfred format)
entries.description: Type case and some words to get camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case and more. A script plugin that needs Node.js.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Password generator (Python)
entries.description: pw gives random passwords, PINs and tokens, pw 24 sets the length. Offline; needs Python 3.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: ID generator (Python)
entries.description: id gives a UUID v4, a time-sortable UUID v7, a ULID and a NanoID. Offline; needs Python 3.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Color converter (Python)
entries.description: color #ff8800 shows HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV and WCAG contrast; also takes rgb(), hsl() and names. Offline; needs Python 3.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Lorem ipsum (Python)
entries.description: lorem 3 paragraphs or lorem 40 words gives placeholder text to copy. Offline; needs Python 3.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Hash calculator (Python)
entries.description: hash some text, or the full path of a file, for MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 and more. Offline; needs Python 3.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Color tools
entries.description: Convert HEX, RGB and HSL colors or check text contrast. Try colors #f5b52c or colors #fff on #111. Requires Node.js 22+.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Pomodoro
entries.description: Focus and break timers with pause, resume and saved progress. Type pomo start 25. Check time with pomo status; no background alarms. Requires Node.js 22+.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Translate in browser
entries.description: Type tr fr hello to open Google Translate with automatic source detection. Text is sent only when you open the result. Requires Node.js 22+.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Tauri docs
entries.description: Search a curated local index of Tauri 2 guides. Type tauri updater; Enter opens the official page. Requires Node.js 22+.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: JWT decoder (Python)
entries.description: jwt <token> decodes a JSON Web Token's header, payload and expiry in plain language. Decode only, no signature check. Offline; needs Python 3.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Number base converter (Python)
entries.description: base 255, base 0xff or base ff 16: binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal side by side. Offline; needs Python 3.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Cron explainer (Python)
entries.description: cron 30 9 * * mon-fri says in words when a cron expression runs and lists its next five run times. Offline; needs Python 3.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Regex tester (Python)
entries.description: rx pattern :: text lists every match and capture group of a regular expression (Python syntax). Offline; needs Python 3.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Unicode lookup (Python)
entries.description: uni U+1F600, uni a pasted character or uni right arrow: code point, name, UTF-8 bytes, HTML entity and escapes. Offline; needs Python 3.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: HTTP status codes (Python)
entries.description: http 404, http redirect or http timeout explains what an HTTP status code means. Built-in table. Offline; needs Python 3.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Port reference (Python)
entries.description: port 5432 or port ssh: what a TCP/UDP port is normally used for, including common dev-server ports. Never scans. Offline; needs Python 3.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: chmod calculator (Python)
entries.description: chmod 755 or chmod rwxr-xr-x converts Unix permissions between octal and symbolic and explains each class. Calculates only. Offline; needs Python 3.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Date calculator (Python)
entries.description: days 2026-12-25, days +90 or days 2026-01-01 2026-12-31: days until or between dates, and a date plus or minus N days. Offline; needs Python 3.
entries.author: Sevak

entries.name: Slugify and text stats (Python)
entries.description: slug Hello World! gives a URL slug and a safe file name, with character, word, byte and reading-time counts. Offline; needs Python 3.
entries.author: Sevak
